requirement_text: Applicants are required to hold the established Leaving Certificate (or an approved equivalent) with a minimum of six subjects which must include: Two H5 (Higher Level) grades and Four O6 (Ordinary Level) grades or four H7 (Higher Level) grades.

requirement_text: A minimum grade H4 in Mathematics and grade O6/H7 in one of: Physics, Chemistry, Physics with Chemistry, Engineering, Technology, Design & Communication Graphics/Technical Drawing, Computer Science, Biology, Agricultural Science, Applied Maths, or Construction Studies. A special mathematics exam is available post-results for those missing the Mathematics requirement.

researcher_notes: 'Common Entry' means students enter a shared first year before choosing a specific engineering specialisation; this program name is UL's own course title, not necessarily a 1:1 label match to any single specialisation-level program name elsewhere in ORYN's catalogue.

requirement_text: At the time of an offer, an applicant is required to hold the Leaving Certificate (or equivalent), with a minimum of six subjects including: Grade H5 or better in at least two subjects and Grade O6/H7 or better in at least four subjects together with a minimum of F6 in Mathematics, O6/H7 in English, and O6/H7 in another recognised language, and O6/H7 in one of the following science subjects: Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Physics/Chemistry or Agricultural Science. The minimum points are 480 points from the same sitting of the Leaving Certificate Examination or equivalent. Points scores above 550 will be moderated.
source_authority_note: ul.ie is the official University of Limerick domain but does not match the narrow .edu/.ac./.gov authority-gate pattern used by lib/acquisition/source-authority.ts.
limitations: No cycle year stated on the page itself. Per the national CAO-system research, the Leaving Certificate/HPAT points-moderation formula is confirmed changing for 2027 entry (moderation above 550 removed, HPAT max weighting reduced 300→150); this UL page's 'points above 550 will be moderated' statement was not independently dated to a specific cycle in this pass and should be re-checked closer to each admissions cycle.
researcher_notes: UL's medicine page did not state a separate minimum HPAT score for standard school-leaver entry (only UL's mature-entry route was found elsewhere to require 'a HPAT of 140 or above'). Do not conflate the mature-entry HPAT floor with standard entry.

requirement_text: CAO applicants must complete the Health Professions Admission Test (HPAT) in the year of admission to the medicine course.
source_authority_note: ul.ie is the official University of Limerick domain but does not match the narrow .edu/.ac./.gov authority-gate pattern used by lib/acquisition/source-authority.ts.
researcher_notes: UL is one of the 6 Irish medical schools requiring HPAT-Ireland nationally, per the parallel CAO-system research (University of Galway, University of Limerick, Trinity, UCC, UCD, RCSI).

requirement_text: All applicants must demonstrate English proficiency. Those whose first language is not English need test results issued within two years before the start of your course (i.e. for entry in September 2026, only results attained since 01 February 2024 will be accepted). Minimum standards include IELTS score of 6.5 with no less than 6.0 in any component, or equivalent qualifications from recognized examinations listed in the requirements table.

researcher_notes: cycle_year set to 2026 because the page itself ties the 2-year test-validity window explicitly to 'entry in September 2026' -- this is a directly stated cycle anchor, not an inference.
